create_IBOTHook: create an IBOTHook instance to handle EMA teacher creation and forward pass for iBOT self-supervised learning
build_momentum_network: build a momentum teacher network with zero drop path rate for the iBOT student-teacher architecture
run_teacher_forward: run a forward pass on the momentum teacher using only global view crops from the student input batch
update_momentum_network: update the momentum teacher network with cosine schedule and configurable teacher momentum
configure_IBOTHook: configure an IBOTHook with teacher temperature schedule and momentum schedule for iBOT training
